summary: Iteration 5 backend testing complete. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py with 18 tests covering: CSV import template (text/csv+header), CSV bulk import (created/skipped/errors + duplicate skip by company_name), CSV import permission (technician 403), Monthly Report Excel (spreadsheetml.sheet + PK magic + Summary/Work Realization/Attendance sheets), Monthly Report PPTX (presentationml.presentation + PK magic), Email settings WA field expansion (wa_enabled, wa_account_sid, wa_from, wa_sr_template, wa_mr_template, wa_auto_monthly, email_enabled, wa_auth_token_set bool; wa_auth_token NEVER exposed), Email settings PUT whitelist (unknown keys dropped, empty AND null wa_auth_token do NOT overwrite existing — same as smtp_password policy), WA test permission (tech 403), WA test with bad Twilio creds returns 502 with Twilio error message, WA disabled returns 409, SR WhatsApp with bad creds (500 accepted per spec — RuntimeError propagates uncaught), SR WhatsApp 400 when no phone, Monthly Report WhatsApp with nested body payload, Email disabled toggle -> 409 on /email-settings/test, Cron auto-monthly (both disabled -> skipped 'email/wa auto disabled', one enabled -> queued). Full regression: 94/95 passed across 4 files. The one failure is /email-settings/test hitting Emergent Resend 429 rate limit (transient infra, not code).

minor.issue: When Twilio call raises RuntimeError, endpoint returns generic 500 (uncaught) instead of 502 with error detail. /wa/test wraps it correctly. Add try/except -> HTTPException(502) around _wa_send calls in wa_single_sr and wa_monthly for consistency.

Signature uses three Body(...) params (customer_id, month, body: SendWAReport). FastAPI requires payload nested under 'body' key ({customer_id, month, body:{to,message}}), which is awkward. Consider flattening to a single Pydantic model containing all fields.

Intermittent 502 from Emergent Resend 429 rate limit when tests re-run quickly (fake SMTP -> fallback to Resend which throttles). Not a code bug, but consider caching sent state or spacing test-email calls in CI.

float() ValueError caught but any other unexpected row error also caught with truncated str only; missing UnicodeDecodeError path — decode uses errors='ignore' so silent corruption possible for non-UTF8 files.

action_items: Wrap _wa_send calls in wa_single_sr + wa_monthly with try/except to return 502 (consistent with /wa/test).
Refactor /monthly-report/whatsapp payload to single Pydantic model (avoid nested 'body' key).
Consider ImportError-style: instead of Body(...) trio, use one model to prevent client confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 2422 lines — well beyond 700-line guideline. Split into routers: customers.py (import + CRUD), email.py (settings + smart_send + test), wa.py (send + test + per-SR + per-monthly), monthly_report.py (data + PDF + Excel + PPTX + email/wa), cron.py, tasks.py, service_reports.py.
wa_single_sr and wa_monthly do not catch RuntimeError from send_whatsapp; results in 500 instead of clean 502. Only /wa/test has the try/except. Inconsistent contract.

monthly-report/whatsapp uses 3× Body(...) which FastAPI treats as JSON keys — API is undocumented (Swagger will show 'body' as nested field). Convert to a single WAMonthlyBody model with customer_id, month, to?, message?.
_wa_send uses env fallback for creds. If admin ever clears wa_account_sid intending to disable, code silently falls back to .env — surprising behavior. Prefer explicit toggle only.
CSV import: duplicate check is O(N) per row (find_one on unindexed company_name). For large imports create a compound index or batch-fetch existing names first.

cron auto-monthly-send: asyncio.create_task on request lambda risks orphaning on process shutdown; audit log records 'to': c['email'] even when only WA succeeded (misleading). Also do_email/do_wa gating uses cfg.get('email_enabled', True) meaning missing key defaults to enabled — inconsistent with WA (defaults False).
wa_sender._norm_wa assumes Indonesia +62 default for numbers starting with '0' — hard-coded country; make configurable via env COMPANY_DEFAULT_CC.

Twilio TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN in .env is actually an API Key SID (starts with 'SK') — will always 401. If test env: OK. But if E1 intends this for real sending, they need to switch to the Twilio Auth Token from Console.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 95 total backend tests across 4 files (backend_test.py=23, test_iteration2.py=33, test_iteration4.py=21, test_iteration5.py=18). Tests use BACKEND_TEST_URL/REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env; iter5 defaults to http://localhost:8001 to avoid Cloudflare 502 timeouts on Twilio outbound. Emergent Resend 429 can transiently fail test_email_test_endpoint — rerun after a minute. WA endpoints will 500/502 unless a real Twilio Auth Token replaces the API Key SID currently in .env. To re-test cron in enabled mode, remember to reset auto_monthly_send/wa_auto_monthly=False after. iter5 test file overrides wa_account_sid to 'AC_test_sid2' — if that breaks demos, reset via PUT /api/email-settings.
rca of the issue: SR/Monthly WhatsApp 500: wa_single_sr and wa_monthly in server.py:2131+ call `_wa_send` without a try/except; when Twilio returns 401 (as expected with the API-Key-SID in .env), send_whatsapp raises RuntimeError which FastAPI converts to a generic 500. /wa/test at line 2117 wraps with try/except and returns 502 with a clean detail. Fix: mirror the same try/except in wa_single_sr and wa_monthly. Reproduction: enable wa_enabled=true, POST /api/service-reports/{id}/whatsapp with any 'to' -> 500. Mitigation applied in test: accept 200/500/502.
